title: Pick and register a DNS name for a "MIMI net" (a network of MIMI providers)
description:
Mark 2026-11-17: we need a good DNS name for a 'mimi net'; come back to it later.

Checked 2026-11-17 via registry RDAP (404 = unregistered; premium pricing not checked):
- Free: mimi.exchange (Claude's pick), mimifed.org (second), interop.chat, mimi.foundation, mimi.directory, joinmimi.org, mimiinterop.org, mimi-net.org, openmimi.net (openmimi.org is taken by someone else).
- Taken: mimi.com, mimi.org, mimi.net (Name.com since 2001, renews 2027-01-31), mimi.chat, mimi.network, mimi.social, mimi.dev, miminet.com/.net/.org, openmimi.org, mimi.community, mimi.zone, mimi.link, mimi.place.
- Unknown: mimi.im (.im has no RDAP).

Notes: 'MIMI' is the IETF WG's name; avoid names that read as official (mimi.foundation). Free stopgap: a subdomain of reviewcommit.com (Epik, DNSSEC works; changes need Mark's OK, via joumon). Registering is Mark's action; after that, DNS and DNSSEC setup with his OK.

Open questions for Mark: what the net is for (directory of providers, test federation, public onboarding), and so which name fits.
